about: A marquise centre is set north–south with two small round natural diamonds on the shoulders, each in its own bezel. The long axis of the marquise stretches the finger.
why_this_works: The two side stones echo the centre without competing with it, and their bezels keep the profile low. The marquise's length gives the most visual size per carat of any shape we set.
wedding_band_fit: Needs a contour band to clear the points of the marquise.

specifications.wedding_band_fit: Needs a contour band to clear the points of the marquise.
